prose.text: The chunk's own entries come first, then the standard gate set in test-plan §3 order. `capability-drift` precedes the default-features workspace nextest. The `--features mcp-server` regen and the base-identity bindings close come last, since no procedure is added. The reading and the operator pass follow.

Absences, each with its reason: - No `pulse-app/ui/**` path is touched, so the webview gates are absent, and there is no headful self-verify. - No boot path is touched (`main.rs`, `observability.rs`, `ui-bridge`, `tauri.conf.json` and the capabilities stay   unchanged), so no boot-smoke entry is listed. The reading boots no app: the probe spawns `llama-cli` itself. - No local pre-push gate: `cargo xtask pre-push:linux` cannot run on this host (it needs WSL; its route entry is still   ahead). CI's `lint-test` job is the gate the push meets. - No dependency is added; the scope guard asserts `Cargo.toml` and `Cargo.lock` unchanged. - No liveness probe keyed `round` precedes the reading: it drives no external process an entry could check first. Its   precondition is the operator's slot entry before it, no `llama-cli` resident on the GPU.

The reading is two-armed by design. Exit 0 (PASS) and exit 1 (FAIL) are both a completed, recorded verdict; exit 2 measured nothing. Its entry therefore asserts that the run completed and printed its lines, never an exit, and the verdict word is carried into the report's Outcome. A FAIL is never reported as passed (leaned per the 2026-10-04 slot-2 precedent, `…names-the-retry-on-every-storm-shape/plan.md:302-309`, and architecture.md §Established Decisions [Fault Identity]).

The regression guard is read off the same run's last line. When it reads TRIPPED, Step 12 restores three files to the chunk base and every non-leg entry runs again on that tree before the operator pass; the entries are written to be green in both states (the interpretation run, the probe run, both dry-runs, the scope guard). The reading itself is never fired a second time.

Producers of what the criteria read: `evidence/preregistration.md`, `evidence/red-before-green.md`, `evidence/mutation-checks.md`, `evidence/prompt-sizes.md`, `evidence/reading.md` and `evidence/regression-guard.md` are written by /implement from the entries' recorded outputs. The series' own files land under the gitignored `target/l4-decision-probe/`.

The Step 9 mutations edit source and revert, so each is a ONE-SHOT run at implement, both readings in `evidence/mutation-checks.md`; the non-mutating probe and interpretation unit entries guard the same properties on every re-run. The instrument this chunk builds, the grader and the bar, meets its known-verdict controls before its one graded use: the Step 5 pairs (statements it must pass and must fail) and the Step 8 selection pins (synthetic counts for each of the four outcomes) run in the probe unit entry, which precedes the reading.
